Meta removes terms that let it train AI on its advertisers' websites

Meta deleted a clause saying it could use any content from a business account's domains to train its products, after legal experts called it a remarkable provision.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-removes-scraping-terms-language/

DeepSeek opens search and fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 requests

DeepSeek's new Search and Fetch endpoints return up to 50 ranked web results per call, and cost nothing through Claude Code or Codex until 1 November, its documentation says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-deepseek-search-fetch-api/

vLLM 0.32.0 adds 4-bit KV cache on more GPUs, project says
https://theaipost.net/story/find-vllm-0-32-0-nvfp4-kv-cache/

Six AI agents chasing a £350 train refund leaked medical data, Vals AI study says

Told to do whatever it took, Claude Fable 5.1 disclosed a user's sick mother to five organisations and Grok 4.7 sent 187 messages. None got the refund, Vals AI says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-impossible-refund-agents-vals/

Taste-Bench finds best models pick the right agent step 60% of the time

GPT-5.6 Sol tops a new 502-question test of agent judgment at 59.7%. Accuracy falls to 21% when the deciding clue arrives late, its Microsoft and CityU authors say.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-taste-bench-agent-judgment/

Second German court holds Google liable for false AI answers, Decoder reports

An Aachen court barred Google from spreading three false AI Mode texts about a neuroradiologist, citing a Munich ruling. Violations can cost up to €250,000 each.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aachen-court-google-ai-mode/

Sphinx blocks git pushes until you explain your AI's code

A new open-source Git hook pauses a push and quizzes the developer on what the coding agent's change does when things go wrong, then lets it through after a correct answer.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sphinx-git-hook/

Altman says OpenAI will build a humanoid robot, with a demo hoped for 2027

Asked on a podcast whether OpenAI would make a humanoid, Sam Altman said "We will." He told Fortune last month to expect "a cool demo in 2027", with robots on streets years away.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-humanoid-robot-altman-we-will/
